subject: SOC 2 renewal: evidence handoff, retention window change & seat commitment bump
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@acme-health.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.inference.com
Cc: contracts@acme-health.com; salesops@acme-health.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 renewal + evidence upload window — Acme Health

Rohan,

Hope you're well — our renewal window for the platform is coming up (Nov 15). BrightShield will run our re-attestation and they asked for a consolidated evidence handoff and confirmation of log retention dates. A few asks from our side:

- Confirm the retention window for audit logs (we currently need 18 months)
- Provide a manifest of evidence you will share and a preferred upload mechanism (SFTP/GDrive/secure portal)
- Confirm whether a short-term seat increase (from 3 to 5 seats) for the audit period is possible and whether that changes the renewal timeline/pricing

We'd like to lock these details by Oct 7 so our procurement and legal teams can align. BrightShield is on standby for the evidence ingest once you confirm the method.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Head of Security & Compliance
Acme Health

Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal + evidence upload window — Acme Health

Julia — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes on supporting 18 months retention for the audit window, yes on a temporary seat bump during the audit, and BrightShield can use our secure evidence portal (we'll provision a tenant).

Next steps I propose:
1) Sean (security) will confirm the exact logs and retention adjustments we can expose and provide a redlined retention doc.
2) Marissa (account lead) will draft a one-page amendment for the seat bump + nominal fees so procurement can review.
3) I'll coordinate the evidence portal access and send the manifest template BrightShield prefers.

Target dates: portal & manifest by 10/4, amendment draft by 10/6. Do those timelines work for you?

Regards,
Rohan Mehta

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.inference.com; marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal + evidence upload window — retention scope

Rohan / Marissa — summary of my findings after syncing with infra:

- Retention: We can extend the audit-log retention from our default 12 months to 18 months for the Acme tenant. This requires a short-lived config change to the log-archival policy and a manual export of the last 6 months of cold logs into the secure portal.
- Data shape: We'll deliver: sequence-indexed request logs (redacted PII), slow-query traces, and runtime container-level events. We will not expose raw user payloads — those remain redacted per contract.
- Access controls: BrightShield will get a read-only service account with MFA and IP allowlist.
- Effort: ~8 engineer-hours for export + policy change; ETA 10/3 for the export prepared and 10/4 for portal readiness.
- Notes on audit seats: Seats are licensing tokens for audit console access — granting 2 extra temporary seats during Oct 15–Nov 30 is feasible. Pricing: flat $1,200 for the audit period (non-recurring).

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv (stub)

I'll prepare the redlined retention PDF and drop into the Drive link Rohan will share.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com

From: BrightShield Audit <audit@brightshield.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.inference.com; julia.park@acme-health.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Instructions for evidence ingest + manifest format

Hello team — thanks for the heads-up. Two quick notes:

1) Preferred ingest: secure SFTP to a temporary bucket is ideal; if Redwood's portal supports pre-signed, short-lived URLs that's also acceptable.
2) Manifest: CSV with columns "artifact_name, artifact_type, created_at, sha256, notes". Small examples are fine.

We're standing by to begin the ingest once Rohan provisions access. If you prefer BrightShield to pull logs via an API, we can coordinate an OIDC client.

Regards,
Olga Petrov (BrightShield Lead Auditor)
BrightShield Audit

All — quick status update and items I'm attaching: amendment_ACM-4782.docx (seat bump + term note) and redwood-log-retention-change-draft.pdf (policy redline).

Status:
- Portal: provisioned; BrightShield account created (read-only, MFA, IP allowlist). Access link: https://portal.redwood.inference.com/evidence/acme-health (expires 10/31).
- Evidence manifest: attached CSV template (evidence_manifest.csv). Please populate entries with checksums as you export.
- Retention: Sean confirmed 18-month retention will be in effect for the period Oct 1, 2026 — Dec 31, 2027 to cover the audit window.
- Seats: Marissa has put the one-time fee line in the amendment. Marissa — can you please confirm legal wording for the amendment and we'll route to Acme procurement?

Julia — if this looks good I'll open the DocuSign envelope for the amendment and we can start the evidence ingest on Monday (10/5).
